# Dr Sarah McKay

> A neuroscientist's hub for brain health education, authored books, professional training courses, and science communication on female brain health and neuroscience.

Dr Sarah McKay is an Australian neuroscientist specializing in applied neuroscience, brain health, and the female brain. She offers online training programs for health professionals and coaches, publishes books including The Women's Brain Book, and delivers keynote speaking engagements internationally.

## Key Topics

- Applied Neuroscience
- Brain Health
- Female Brain
- Pregnancy and Motherhood
- Hormones and Neuroscience
- Menopause
- Neuroscience Education
- Neuroscience Training
- Women's Brain Health
- Brain Science Communication
- The Women's Brain Book
- The Neuroscience Academy
- Health Professionals
- Keynote Speaking
- Online Training
